Church of Elleh

Game: Elden Ring.

Church of Elleh is a location in Elden Ring. Before moving on, rest at the Site of Grace inside Church of Elleh to replenish health and flask charges. Merchant Kale sells the Crafting Kit here. These nearby preparation steps can be done without fighting an enemy or leaving the church. The ruined church is near the beginning of Limgrave.
